use_case: Wipro to scale adoption of AI agents that learn from enterprise experience
reported_outcomes: "Building frontier AI requires bringing exceptional domain expertise closer to the teams developing and deploying AI systems," said Manu Sharma, CEO of Labelbox. "Through our partnership with Wipro, we look forward to helping enterprises turn their knowledge, workflows, and standards into AI systems that can be rigorously evaluated, continuously improved, and deployed responsibly at scale.
